intents: Who is our audience and who should we target?
What do our customers want and what problems do they have?
What words does our audience use?
Where does our audience hang out — communities, newsletters, podcasts, events?
Find me 50 right-fit people with verified emails (list mode)
Give me an ABM target list (list mode)
reads: brand brain: summary, kit audience text, products, competitors, organic, learnings (learn-my-brand); customer evidence via knowledge_search
workspace research/market/ — segments, voice-of-customer bank, demand read (research-market): reused, never redone
workspace research/audience/ — last profile, report, segment notes, ledger (this playbook, earlier runs); research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md (spend-gate)
claims via claims-gate (learn-my-brand) — for messages and proof lines
human-supplied (list mode): exclusions export, email-checker results, outreach outcomes
writes: local gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<date>-audience.md and workspace research/audience/<date>-report.md → 'Audience report — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history) via write-report and save-to-brain — read by the marketer and the next run

workspace research/audience/profile.md → 'Audience profile — <Brand> — <date>' (supersede) — read by plan-campaign (channels), make-content and run-organic-social (words, places), work-with-creators (who the audience follows)
workspace research/audience/segments/<slug>.md — read by the next run
list mode: research/audience/<date>-<list>/list.csv, dropped.csv; research/audience/ledger.csv via outcomes-ledger — read by the marketer's outreach tool and later runs
research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md rows — read by every playbook's spend estimates
